singleSourced.key: a couple of very exciting new projects in very early stages
singleSourced.value: a couple of very exciting new projects in very early stages
singleSourced.context: He did not specify further, except that there are "a couple of very exciting new projects in very early stages" that will "expand the canon of The Last of Us beyond Part I and Part II." Naughty Dog hasn't shared whether these are standalone games or expansions for existing titles.

In August, the studio announced it had wrapped up its "very ambitious Intergalactic cinematic shoot."

If that sounds familiar, that's because Druckmann posted something very similar on social media in 2019 when Naughty Dog wrapped its "most ambitious cinematic shoot [it's] ever done"—for The Last of Us Part II.
